ontology.note: Emits fw:RasterPointSample with the sampled attribute, the cell size, the stated sampling convention, the unit status and four counts. The term is declared for this release; a shape over it is not yet written.

changes.description: Writes the value of the raster cell containing each point onto that point, under PixelIsArea with no interpolation. Closes the gap experiment 62 found: the elevation attribute Compare level to elevation requires could not be produced in the application at all. No-data cells, points outside the raster and points without coordinates carry no value and are counted separately; none is zero-filled. An attribute already present on the layer is refused rather than overwritten, and a raster on another CRS is refused because no datum shift exists.

evidence.note: Seven unit checks cover the containing-cell value, no-data and masked cells, points outside the grid, points without coordinates, the half-open cell edges, a refused existing attribute, refused attribute names and a refused CRS. A cell value is not a measurement at the point and no interpolation is claimed. Agreement with an external point sampler is not established; see docs/experiments/67-sample-raster-at-points.md. Composition is established by tests/composition-elevation.test.mjs, a minimal fixture wiring Area around a point to Clip raster to Sample raster at points with synthetic data. The sea-level worked example remains the teaching artifact and does not gate this release; see the protective/maturity distinction in docs/audits/ontology-audit.md.
